items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Yes, yeah, he's our manager now. He leads the band.

ctx.x: Yes, yeah, he's our manager now. He leads the band. Yeah, he's doing a pretty good job at it. Keeping things going pretty good. Yeah, we've got a few jobs coming up. We're playing Saturday at the Fairgrounds. Which one of the guys was that? Racetrack on? Yes, uh-huh. I met you. It's a night dance. We usually play here in the deer when they have the horse show. Yeah. But this is something going on, some kind of dance going on Saturday night. We're playing from 8 to 12. Oh, yeah. We went to Pensacola Saturday past.…
How do you travel now, Brian?

We have a station wagon. Nine passenger, uh, Plymouth. Push Button station wagon. Yeah. Yeah, we've been traveling with that. Well, uh, we have the bus yet. You have a bus that I remember you. We still have the bus. We've got the license for it. We've got the brake tags for it. But he tried to get insurance for each trip. Uh-huh. But they won't give him insurance like that. They say you have to buy it a whole year.
